name: Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: American Wrestling Alliance's own top belt, described on its own page as the centre piece of the promotion before anyone had worn it. Its first card's main event was announced as a qualifier for the tournament that would crown a champion; no tournament bracket, match or champion survives.
notes: heavyweight.html, the fed's own championship page; no reign is attested anywhere in this deposit.

name: Trios Tag Team Championships
epitaph: Three belts held together by a team of three, carrying their own rule set: a partner who leaves the ring is replaced without a tag, breaking up a pinfall is legal, and the team that breaks one up then has eight seconds to run a move of its own. American Wrestling Alliance staged a trios match on its first card and planned one on nearly every event; no champion survives.
notes: triostag.html, the fed's own championship page; no reign is attested anywhere in this deposit.
